answer: Re-attestations are stored in shale and ivory lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the vertex graph. Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 20 epochs, which means holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm of 3854 identities would post 925 proofs and burn roughly 34 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
